<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA must cover TelNet one-to-many with Maple & Crown and WaveConnect one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need separate TelNet GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and separate WaveConnect GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. Additionally, we require a single FiberLink application that manages SkyNet, both one-to-many.

Please send me the drafts as soon as they are ready!

Thanks.

GP
</body>

cc:  
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA removing the distinction between transactions on WaveConnect and transactions on TelNet. If Maple & Crown is the sole party allowed to post service offers on WaveConnect, then the special rules we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" marketplace are unnecessary. However, we will need to create a separate set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown completes on WaveConnect, since the services offered there differ from those covered by Maple & Crown’s standard GTCs.
